name: CZ-series secretary/business communications droid
description: The CZ-series secretary/business communications droid, also known as the CZ protocol droid, was a model of secretary droid produced by Serv-O-Droid, Inc. that acted as the precursor to the protocol droid. The droids had reliable and sturdy construction, with heavy plating that protected them from any serious damage, and so they were found throughout the galaxy long after their manufacturer went out business.
